description: Lab Result Catalogue (Phase A seed) — coded results, investigations and a suggested lab definition. NOT yet read by any feature; see docs/plans/LAB-RESULT-CATALOGUE-DATA-MODEL-2026-09-19.md. Refsets are TRUD PCD cluster ids (attribute only, never panel membership); "counts for QOF" is derived from them, never stored here.

investigations.label: U&E
investigations.note: Blood urea and electrolytes. A urine electrolytes panel is excluded. Requests may say WITH or WITHOUT potassium; a report without potassium still clears the request (partial group clears).

investigations.label: HbA1c
investigations.note: HbA1c is a code family: only the IFCC concepts count for QOF (see the result's refsets).

investigations.label: Liver function tests
investigations.note: ALP and albumin are shared with the bone profile and are optional for clearing a request.

investigations.label: Thyroid function
investigations.note: UK labs reflex-test thyroid (TSH first), so a TSH-only report is the complete thyroid result. Free T3 and Free T4 are requested and reported separately at this practice (see the Free T3 / Free T4 tests) — they are not bundled members of Thyroid function here.

investigations.label: Free T4
investigations.note: Can be requested on its own or added on to thyroid function.

investigations.label: Free T3
investigations.note: Can be requested on its own or added on to thyroid function.

investigations.label: Bone profile
investigations.note: Calcium, ALP and albumin are shared (also reported with LFTs / a lone calcium) and are optional for clearing a request.

investigations.label: Urine MC&S (MSU)
investigations.note: The report splits into three separate lines (pus cells, epithelial cell count, culture) — confirmed live 2026-09-26. Pus cells is the sole core/anchor result (the defining finding); epithelial cell count and culture are optional. A hospital lab (Kingston, General Pathology) separately reports White cells as its own text result under this same test, at that lab only.
